title: 2001 AMC 12 Problem 22
statement: In rectangle \(ABCD,\) points \(F\) and \(G\) lie on \(\overline{AB}\) so that \(AF = FG = GB\) and \(E\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{DC}.\) Also, \(\overline{AC}\) intersects \(\overline{EF}\) at \(H\) and \(\overline{EG}\) at \(J.\) The area of rectangle \(ABCD\) is \(70.\) Find the area of triangle \(EHJ.\)

solutions.text:
Triangle \(EFG\) has base \(FG = \dfrac{1}{3}AB\) and height equal to the rectangle’s height, so its area is \(\dfrac{1}{6}(70) = \dfrac{35}{3}.\)

Because \(EC \parallel AF,\) triangles \(AFH\) and \(CEH\) are similar with ratio \(\dfrac{EC}{AF} = \dfrac{3}{2},\) so \(\dfrac{EH}{EF} = \dfrac{3}{5}.\) Likewise \(\dfrac{EJ}{EG} = \dfrac{3}{7}.\)

Then \(\dfrac{[EHJ]}{[EFG]}\) \(= \dfrac{EH}{EF}\cdot\dfrac{EJ}{EG}\) \(= \dfrac{3}{5}\cdot\dfrac{3}{7}\) \(= \dfrac{9}{35},\) giving \[ [EHJ] = \dfrac{9}{35}\cdot\dfrac{35}{3} = 3. \]

Thus, the correct answer is C.
